d:
Haidrabad men aayojit bharat samit 2026 men shamil hone aa rahin norve ki patrakar hela ling ko bharat men pravesh ki anumti nahin milne ka mamla vivadon men hai. hela ka aarop hai ki viza aur rajnitik manjuri milne ke bavjud unhen bharat aane se rok diya gaya. unhonne iske lie maee 2026 men pradhanmantri narendr modi se puchhe gae apne savalon ko vajah bataya hai.
Vahin, kangres neta salman khurshid ne dava kiya hai ki karib 116 videshi pratinidhiyon ko viza manjuri nahin mili. samit ke aayojkon ne bhi videshi mehmanon ko imigreshan ke dauran pareshan kie jane ke aarop lagae hain.
